items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The two added lines are clear and match the existing raw()/values() guard style. But the error message "Prefetch querysets cannot use slices." states a restriction the issue asked to remove, so a reader is misled about intent, and the docs were not updated to mention it.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The guard sits in Prefetch.__init__ in query.py, while the logic that needs changing is in get_prefetch_queryset in related_descriptors.py. It hard-codes the restriction, so the feature has to be built later anyway and this check deleted. No helper and no reuse of Window/RowNumber.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The input is checked at the boundary with a specific ValueError, nothing is swallowed and there are no magic constants. But this turns a valid use case into an error instead of supporting it.

items.name: Per-parent slice semantics for open/bounded slices
items.name_zh: 开放/有界切片按父对象分区
items.evidence: No per-parent slicing is done: `if queryset is not None and queryset.query.is_sliced: raise ValueError(...)`. Every sliced Prefetch, open (qs[n:]) or bounded (qs[n:m]), now raises an error. F2P 0/4 (test_foreignkey_reverse, test_m2m_forward, etc.).
